body:
This has been asked before but it just died out, and since Sr Staff are taking suggestions I'm thinking why not make a new post to remind them about it.

So like badlion has (not sure about other servers) you have the ability to change your hotbar for 1v1's and 2v2's and all that

Would save everybodies time because not everybody has the same setup for the hotbar :)
That is all for me today!
Have a great day kiddos :)
